description: Load an uploaded SNP distance edgelist, launch the network, switch to Heatmap, and verify the rendered Plotly matrix matches the backing distance matrix.
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; SNPS metric label renders; Plotly x/y/z state matches commonService.getDM() for the uploaded edgelist.
notes: This is the maintained Heatmap edgelist baseline.

description: Load an uploaded TN93 distance matrix, launch the network, switch to Heatmap, and verify the rendered Plotly matrix matches the backing distance matrix.
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; TN93 metric label renders; Plotly x/y/z state matches commonService.getDM() for the uploaded matrix.
notes: This is the maintained Heatmap controls/export fixture as well as a file-type smoke baseline.

description: Load uploaded FASTA, let the app derive distances, switch to Heatmap, and verify the Plotly matrix matches the derived distance matrix.
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; SNPS metric label renders; Plotly x/y/z state matches commonService.getDM() for the derived FASTA distances.
notes: This keeps Heatmap covered on a sequence-derived SNP path rather than only on precomputed matrices.

description: Load separate node and link files, switch to Heatmap, and verify the Plotly matrix matches the merged uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; Plotly x/y/z state matches commonService.getDM() after node/link merge; launch metrics stay stable.
notes: This covers the merged uploaded-file path instead of only single-file inputs.

description: Load a node list with sequences, let the app derive TN93 distances, switch to Heatmap, and verify the Plotly matrix matches the derived matrix.
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; TN93 metric label renders; Plotly x/y/z state matches commonService.getDM() for the derived sequence-node-list path.
notes: This closes the sequence-node-list gap for Heatmap load coverage.

description: Load an uploaded Newick tree, switch to Heatmap, and verify the Plotly matrix matches the patristic matrix returned by getDM().
primary_assertions: Heatmap opens; Plotly z state matches commonService.getDM() for the Newick path; launch metrics stay coherent.
notes: Newick labels remain governed by the current getDM() behavior, so the maintained assertion compares against the app's backing matrix rather than assuming extra label normalization.

description: Open Heatmap Settings, invert the X and Y axes, and verify the rendered Plotly matrix reorders consistently with the backing matrix.
primary_assertions: heatmap-invertX and heatmap-invertY widgets update to true; Plotly x and y labels reverse in the expected direction; Plotly z rows and columns reverse coherently.
notes: The maintained control path uses the TN93 matrix fixture for fast deterministic comparisons against getDM().

description: Enable Show Labels in Heatmap Settings and verify the widget state and Plotly axis-label visibility persist coherently.
primary_assertions: heatmap-axislabels-show updates to true; Plotly xaxis/yaxis showticklabels switches on; reopening Heatmap Settings preserves the enabled state.
notes: Closed HBG001 while wiring this path: the rendered state used to change without persisting the widget.

description: Change the low, medium, and high Heatmap colors and verify the Plotly colorscale updates.
primary_assertions: heatmap-color-low, heatmap-color-medium, and heatmap-color-high widgets update; the rendered Plotly trace colorscale matches the selected colors.
notes: This is the maintained Heatmap color-settings regression signal.

description: Export the Heatmap view as SVG.
primary_assertions: Export Heatmap writes a non-empty SVG file into cypress/downloads/.
notes: Closed HBG002 while wiring this path: export needed a guard for non-gradient Plotly content.

description: Export the current Heatmap distance matrix as CSV with labels enabled.
primary_assertions: The exported CSV payload matches the rendered Plotly header labels row labels and matrix values when Show Labels is enabled.
notes: This is Heatmap-specific export coverage rather than general network export coverage.

subarea: Direct file launch to Heatmap default view
description: Set File Settings default view to Heatmap before launch and confirm the uploaded dataset reaches an interactive Heatmap without requiring a manual view switch.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files overlay should clear and Heatmap should become interactive directly on launch.
notes: File Settings now exposes Heatmap as a launch target and the maintained direct-launch matrix covers all Heatmap-capable uploaded fixture paths.

description: Pan or zoom the rendered Plotly Heatmap, then use Center Screen and verify the baseline autorange is restored.
primary_assertions: Rendered xaxis and yaxis autorange returns to the baseline centered state after Center Screen; the matrix membership and metric label remain unchanged.
notes: This closes the last Heatmap toolbar-control gap in the maintained uploaded-data suite.

description: Export the Heatmap view as PNG from the real export dialog.
primary_assertions: Export Heatmap writes a non-empty PNG file into cypress/downloads/ and the artifact has the expected PNG signature.
notes: PNG now has maintained uploaded-data coverage alongside SVG and JPEG.

description: Export the Heatmap view as JPEG from the real export dialog.
primary_assertions: Export Heatmap writes a non-empty JPEG file into cypress/downloads/ and the artifact has the expected JPEG signature.
notes: JPEG now has maintained uploaded-data coverage alongside SVG and PNG.

subarea: Distance matrix export to CSV without labels
description: Export the current Heatmap distance matrix as CSV with Show Labels disabled.
primary_assertions: The exported CSV payload has no leading header row or label column and its numeric matrix matches the rendered Plotly trace when labels are hidden.
notes: Closed HBG003 while wiring this path: the export logic now serializes the active Heatmap state instead of only the base matrix order.

subarea: Distance matrix export respects active axis inversion
description: Invert X and/or Y in Heatmap Settings, export the distance matrix, and verify the CSV reflects the same label ordering and value orientation shown in the rendered Heatmap.
primary_assertions: Exported CSV header labels and row labels follow the active inverted axes; exported numeric cells align with the rendered Plotly x and y ordering rather than only the base getDM() order.
notes: Closed HBG003 while wiring this path: the maintained regression now compares the exported CSV payload directly to the rendered Plotly trace.

subarea: Post-launch distance metric switch while Heatmap is active
description: Launch sequence-derived data into Heatmap, switch the default distance metric after launch, and verify the rendered Plotly matrix and metric label recompute coherently.
primary_assertions: default-distance-metric updates; the Current Distance Metric label changes; Plotly x/y/z state matches the recomputed commonService.getDM() after the switch.
notes: Closed HBG004 while wiring this path: active Heatmap now redraws on network updates instead of staying stale until manual refresh.

subarea: Background color and contrast on Heatmap
description: Change the global background color while Heatmap is active and verify the computed contrast restyles axis text coherently.
primary_assertions: Plotly main SVG background and rect.bg fill follow background-color; axis text follows the computed background-color-contrast; Heatmap remains interactive after the styling update.
notes: Global background changes now republish visualization updates so active Heatmap tabs restyle without a manual reopen.

description: Change Heatmap-specific settings, close the Heatmap tab or switch away, then reopen Heatmap and verify the prior widget state is reapplied.
primary_assertions: The reopened Heatmap honors invert axes label visibility and chosen colors from session.style.widgets; the rendered Plotly trace still matches getDM() under those settings.
notes: Heatmap now has maintained uploaded-data tab-persistence coverage in the controls journey.

subarea: Session save and reload round-trip for Heatmap
description: Configure Heatmap-specific settings, save a .microbetrace session, reload the app, reopen the saved session, and verify Heatmap state is restored.
primary_assertions: The saved session restores heatmap-invertX, heatmap-invertY, heatmap-axislabels-show, and Heatmap colors; the reopened Heatmap renders the same Plotly ordering and colorscale as before save.
notes: This extends the maintained session round-trip pattern to Heatmap widget state and saved-session reloads.

description: Load a larger Heatmap-capable dataset, switch to Heatmap, and verify Plotly renders without hanging or crashing.
primary_assertions: Heatmap becomes interactive within the timeout; a large Plotly trace exists with the expected dimensions; global stats remain populated; the export dialog still opens.
notes: This adds a maintained scale sentinel beyond the small deterministic Heatmap fixtures.

description: Open the built-in sample session in Heatmap and exercise a minimal view-state smoke pass.
primary_assertions: The Heatmap tab opens on sample data; settings and export dialogs open; the Plotly trace remains interactive after a settings change.
notes: This adds a separate sample-session sentinel alongside the uploaded-data-first Heatmap journeys.
